drafts.text:
HOOK
The Federal Reserve is about to reveal what really happened behind closed doors.
[ON SCREEN: Fed building graphic with "FOMC Minutes"]

WHAT IT IS
The US FOMC Minutes drop today at 14:00 ET, giving traders a detailed look inside the central bank's latest policy debate.
[ON SCREEN: Text "FOMC Minutes: 14:00 ET"]

WHY IT MATTERS
This release can spark sharp swings across the US Dollar Index, EUR/USD, Gold, and the S&P 500. Active traders will comb through the text to see how divided policymakers were on interest rate cuts and economic growth.
[ON SCREEN: Tickers: DXY, EUR/USD, XAU/USD, S&P 500]

WHAT TO WATCH
If the tone leans hawkish, showing persistent inflation worries, the dollar could rally while stocks and Gold pull back. On the other hand, any focus on labor market softness could weaken the dollar and lift equities.
[ON SCREEN: Graphic comparing hawkish vs dovish market reactions]

CLOSE
Catch the full breakdown on FXEmpire.
[ON SCREEN: FXEmpire logo and website URL]

drafts.text:
HOOK
UK inflation is on deck, and sterling traders need to pay close attention to this release.
[ON SCREEN: UK Inflation Rate YoY preview]
WHAT IT IS
The Oct UK inflation rate drops at 02:00 ET. Markets are anticipating 3.6%, compared to 3.5% in the prior reading.
[ON SCREEN: Forecast 3.6% vs Previous 3.5%]
WHY IT MATTERS
This print feeds directly into Bank of England interest rate expectations. That makes it a primary catalyst for GBP/USD, EUR/GBP, and the FTSE 100.
[ON SCREEN: GBP/USD and FTSE 100 chart overlay]
WHAT TO WATCH
If inflation comes in hotter than expected, traders could price in higher interest rates, which might lift the pound against major currencies. If the print lands below 3.6%, easing policy bets could weigh on sterling while giving the FTSE 100 room to move.
[ON SCREEN: Market reaction scenarios]
CLOSE

[ON SCREEN: FXEmpire logo]

drafts.text:
HOOK
Japan's latest inflation report is about to land, and it could set the tone for the yen.
[ON SCREEN: USD/JPY chart]
WHAT IT IS
The Oct inflation rate drops at 18:30 ET. Economists expect the year over year number to come in at 2.0%, down slightly from 2.1% in the prior month.
[ON SCREEN: Forecast 2.0% vs Previous 2.1%]
WHY IT MATTERS
This print matters directly for anyone trading USD/JPY or the Nikkei 225. The Bank of Japan is closely tracking price pressures to decide whether another interest rate hike is justified.
[ON SCREEN: Bank of Japan / Nikkei 225]
WHAT TO WATCH
Watch the surprise factor. If inflation prints higher than 2.0%, traders could price in faster rate hikes, which might lift the yen and pressure the Nikkei. A weaker print could ease hike bets.
[ON SCREEN: Market reaction levels]
CLOSE
Track the full breakdown on FXEmpire.
[ON SCREEN: FXEmpire logo]
